I Mr./Mrs./Ms. {{doc.employee_name}} (EID# {{doc.employee}}), holding Citizenship Identity Card No. {{doc.cid}}, son/daughter of {%if mother%} Mrs. {{mother[0].full_name}}, {%endif%} {%if father%} Mr. {{father[0].full_name}}, {%endif%} {%if (not mother) and (not father) %} Mrs. __________, Mr. _____________, {%endif%} thereby undertake to return to Bhutan upon completion of the studies in {{doc.course_of_study}} (Mention course of study), at {{doc.place_of_study}}, (Mention place and country), sponsored by {{doc.sponsership}}, and continue my service with the Bank for a minimum the duration of the study period as outlined below.

I hereby undertake to:
 1. Pursue the course and complete it within the duration specified.
 2. Not change to another course
 3. Abide by all rules and regulation of the Bank and the institute concerned
 4. Not discontinue the course and / or leave the institute before the completion of the course without written consent from the agency concerned.
 5. Complete my studies and serve the Bank for a maximum period of one time (self-funding) and two times (if sponsored by the Bank) the duration of the course.
 6. Pay to the Bank one times the expenses (self-funding) and two times the expense (company sponsored) incurred by the Bank on the study if:
    6.1 I discontinue the study for a reason within my control; or
    6.2 I fail to produce academic transcript/certificate; or
    6.3 I fail to join and serve the Bank one time the duration of the course (self- funding)
    6.4 I fail to join and serve the Bank two times the duration of the course if sponsored by the Bank.

I, hereby do confirm that I have been briefed on all rules governing my study and I have understood them including the implications and consequences of deviating from them.

In particular, I understand that if I do not adhere to the above stated conditions, my guarantor and/or I will be liable for legal action by the Bank.
